title: Smoke-test CLI version metadata in CI
why: The README release quick-start documents `./omnisstream version`, and the CLI embeds `SPEC_PIN.txt` in that output. CI already checks the submodule pin and runs vector verify/inspect commands, but it does not exercise the documented version command.
suggested_scope: Add a `spec-contract` CI step that runs `cargo run -p omnisstream_cli -- version`.
Keep this separate from vector inspection/verification behavior.
